Synthetic comparative-folding regression fixture, generated with RNAalifold-v2,
ViennaRNA 2.7.0 and MAFFT core 7.505. Four 36-nt designed toy sequences include one
exact duplicate and one compensatory GC→CG substitution pair. These are not
biological tracrRNAs and provide no biological claim. Input source identifiers
are stable. Native evidence is retained for independent contract validation.
